# Provide RxNorm/RxNav-compatible terminology resolution

**Parent:** https://github.com/edithatogo/global-medicines-atlas/issues/1  
**GitHub issue:** https://github.com/edithatogo/global-medicines-atlas/issues/4  
**Conductor phase:** Phase 3  
**Requirements:** M-050–M-053

## Acceptance criteria

- A simple reproducible resolver provides the RxNorm/RxNav effects required by this repository.
- Read-only typed resolver interface.
- Offline fixtures and deterministic local fallback.
- Public RxNav API and optional RxNav-in-a-Box service are interchangeable adapters, not mandatory foundations.
- Local-only licensing controls.
- Unit, integration, smoke, and failure-path tests.
- Provenance-bearing candidate mappings.
